text:
maya: Hey folks — hitting weird parity between JS/Python SDKs when using JSON mode + function calling. Sample app's schema validation is flaky: 'expected object, got null'. JS SDK v1.4.2, Python v1.3.9. Anyone seen this?
juan: Hmm. Is this happening in the normal path or only after an auth/token refresh (retry path)?
maya: Intermittent, seems correlated with auth token refresh retries. Using our retry wrapper around requests. Quick repro: call a tool, model sometimes returns metadata:null and sometimes metadata:{}; our schema expects an object (nullable true). Validator fails when null shows up.
anita: Can you paste the function schema + example outputs? Also which model/runner?
maya: Sure — simplified:
```json
"function spec": {"metadata": {"type": "object", "properties": {"attrs": {"type":"object"}}, "nullable": true}}

model outputs we've seen:
{"metadata": null}
// or sometimes
{"metadata": {}}
```
sam: That smells like an SDK helper coercion. I vaguely remember the JS helper treating empty objects vs null differently in json-mode, especially if the payload got stringified more than once during retry.
juan: Exactly — there was a bug where the retry wrapper double-encodes the tool args (string -> JSON string) and then the json-mode parser runs a second time, causing the sanitizer to sometimes convert {} -> null for nullable object schemas.
ops-bot: deploy: Canary patch shipped to devex on 2026-03-15 12:07 — no new errors in the last 10m :eyes: (automated)
anita: Proposed options: 1) SDK: change sanitizer to never coerce {} -> null for object types (only accept explicit null from model), 2) SDK: add a normalization toggle (e.g., coerceNullObjects: 'preserve'|'toObject'), or 3) Runtime: fix retry double-encode so parser sees consistent raw JSON.
sam: My take: we need deterministic parity between languages. I prefer fixing retry encoding + adding sanitizer unit tests. Normalization toggle is ok as a short-term DX knob for sample apps.
maya: For immediate workaround in sample app I added post-processor: 
```js
if (resp.metadata === null && schema.metadata?.type === 'object') resp.metadata = {}
```
Not ideal but reduces user-facing errors.
juan: I'll open a small issue and assign to eng-ml + devex to investigate retry path and add cross-SDK tests. @sam can you add tests for js/python parity and the sanitizer edge-case?
sam: Yep — will add tests and a starter-kit note about JSON mode caveats.
maya: Thanks all — I'll paste a minimal repro into the sampleapp repo and link the issue. :heart:
